title: Set CRON_SECRET in Vercel Production and redeploy
body: One environment variable turns a dead endpoint into the feature you already built and marked Done. Add it under Project → Settings → Environment Variables (Production), then trigger a deploy — Vercel only picks up new env vars on a fresh build. Check the next morning that the run actually happened.
code:
# after adding CRON_SECRET in the Vercel dashboard (Production):
git pull origin main
git commit --allow-empty -m "chore: redeploy to pick up CRON_SECRET"
git push origin main

# next morning, confirm the run happened:
#   select * from verification_events where created_at > now() - interval '1 day';

title: Fix the address disclosure (41.1 + 41.2 + backfill) before anything else gets built
body: The only item on the board that is a live compliance breach. Stop appending the address to the problem text, add a structured column revealed on acceptance, strip it from the summary prompt. Per the standing rule the migration ships in the same commit as the code, plus a RoPA row and a notice line.

title: Label the AI in Bob chat — the obligation started on 2 August
body: AI Act Art 50 has been applicable since 2 August 2026 and the project rule already commits to labelling. A persistent line in the chat header ("Bob è un assistente AI") plus a note on the privacy page closes it. Cheapest overdue item on the board.

title: Pull Resend activation forward from December to August
body: The pipeline is built and dark. Until it is on, every improvement to the customer journey is invisible to anyone who closes the tab — which is most people. It is a DNS record, a key and a deliverability test, currently scheduled four months after the flows it serves.

title: Run the tracker from the new files and delete the old habits
body: milestones.csv and roadmap.csv are the only things you edit now. The generator writes roadmap.md and roadmap.html; the GitHub Action does it for you on every push that touches them. The xlsx Gantt is retired — the timeline in roadmap.html replaces it at milestone level.
code:
python3 roadmap/build_roadmap.py     # regenerate md + html
python3 roadmap/sync_status.py       # check the CSV against recent commits
open roadmap/roadmap.html            # the view
